coordinates: Each polygon is relative to its anchor root XY, rotated into that anchor root yaw. Whole motion anchor is first source frame; terminal anchor is last source frame.
geometry: Compiled g1_scene.xml robot collision convex mesh vertices; cylinders conservatively use exact world AABB corners. This is reference-pose geometry, not a bound on tracking or transitions.
anchorPoseColumns: root XYZ, quaternion XYZW. Regenerate polygons whenever the corresponding source motion or robot collision geometry changes.
collisionPartCoordinates: Motion XY uses the first root anchor, terminal XY uses the terminal root anchor; minZ/maxZ are absolute source-floor heights. Planar alignment preserves Z.
